newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices fall despite competition.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices fall despite competition.

text.p: Bangladesh tea prices fell at Tuesday's weekly auction, despite competition among overseas buyers, brokers said.
Buyers for Poland were most active and lifted large and bold brokens grades. Afghanistan featured, but major buyer Pakistan was subdued, pushing prices down.
Russia showed interest in medium brokens while domestic buyers lent support at levels below last week's.
The average price was 59.44 taka per kg, down 1.57 taka from the previous sale. Some 905,240 kg was sold. The next sale will be on June 10 with an offer of 0.95 million kg.
